lines.beaver: 다음 주에 해외여행 간다면서요? 어디로 가요?
lines.beaver_en: I heard you're going abroad next week? Where to?
lines.beaver_roman: daeum jue haeoeyeohaeng gandamyeonseoyo? eodiro gayo?
lines.en: Yes, I'm going to Da Nang, and it's my first trip abroad.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, that sounds great! How many days?
lines.learner: 오 일 동안 가요. 항공권은 벌써 샀어요.
lines.en: For five days. I already bought my plane ticket.
lines.roman: o il dongan gayo. hanggonggwoneun beolsseo sasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 잘했네요. 다낭은 경치가 좋은 곳이 많아요.
lines.beaver_en: Good job. Da Nang has lots of places with nice scenery.
lines.beaver_roman: jalhaenneyo. danangeun gyeongchiga joeun gosi manayo.
lines.learner: 경치가 제일 좋은 곳에 꼭 가 보고 싶어요.
lines.en: I really want to visit the place with the best view.
lines.roman: gyeongchiga jeil joeun gose kkok ga bogo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 바나힐에 가 봐요. 산 위인데 정말 예뻐요.
lines.beaver_en: Try going to Ba Na Hills. It's on a mountain and really pretty.
lines.beaver_roman: banahire ga bwayo. san wiinde jeongmal yeppeoyo.
lines.en: Are there many tourists? Crowds are hard for me.

lines.beaver: 좀 많은데 아침 일찍 가면 괜찮아요.
lines.beaver_en: It's a bit crowded, but it's fine if you go early.
lines.beaver_roman: jom maneunde achim iljjik gamyeon gwaenchanayo.
lines.learner: 그럼 아침에 가 볼게요. 관광하고 바다도 볼 거예요.
lines.en: Then I'll try going in the morning. I'll sightsee and see the sea.
lines.roman: geureom achime ga bolgeyo. gwangwanghago badado bol geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. By the way, have you packed your luggage?
lines.learner: 아직요. 짐이 많은데 몇 킬로그램까지 돼요?
lines.en: Not yet. I have a lot. How many kilograms are allowed?
lines.roman: ajingnyo. jimi maneunde myeot killogeuraemkkaji dwaeyo?

lines.beaver: 보통 이십 킬로그램이에요. 항공권을 확인해 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Usually twenty kilograms. Check your ticket.
lines.beaver_roman: botong isip killogeuraemieyo. hanggonggwoneul hwaginhae bwayo.
lines.learner: 네, 확인해 볼게요. 출입국 심사는 어려워요?
lines.en: Okay, I'll check. Is immigration difficult?
lines.roman: ne, hwaginhae bolgeyo. churipguk simsaneun eoryeowoyo?

lines.beaver: 아니요, 여권만 잘 보여 주면 돼요. 쉬워요.
lines.beaver_en: No, just show your passport. It's easy.
lines.beaver_roman: aniyo, yeogwonman jal boyeo jumyeon dwaeyo. swiwoyo.
lines.learner: 다행이에요. 저는 광주에 사는데 공항이 멀어요.
lines.en: That's a relief. I live in Gwangju, so the airport is far.
lines.roman: dahaengieyo. jeoneun gwangjue saneunde gonghangi meoreoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 인천까지 버스로 가요? 일찍 출발해요.
lines.beaver_en: So you're taking a bus to Incheon? Leave early.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom incheonkkaji beoseuro gayo? iljjik chulbalhaeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 새벽에 출발해요. 역시 선배가 최고예요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm leaving at dawn. You really are the best.
lines.roman: ne, saebyeoge chulbalhaeyo. yeoksi seonbaega choegoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 여행 잘 다녀와요. 사진 많이 보내 줘요!
lines.beaver_en: Have a good trip. Send me lots of photos!
lines.beaver_roman: yeohaeng jal danyeowayo. sajin mani bonae jwoyo!
lines.learner: 네, 다녀와서 여행 이야기 많이 해 드릴게요.
lines.en: Sure, I'll tell you all about it when I'm back.
lines.roman: ne, danyeowaseo yeohaeng iyagi mani hae deurilgeyo.
